stories.title: Decades of abuse revealed at Michigan art school. And, the Iran war's impact on midterms
stories.description: A new report has revealed decades of alleged abuse at an elite art school. NPR spoke with one of the victims. And, Iran is playing the long game with negotiations, which could impact midterms.

stories.title: How Iran's 'Axis of Resistance' has shaped the war
stories.description: NPR's Rob Schmitz speaks with Peter Salisbury, professor at Columbia University's School of International and Public Affairs, about how Iran and its allies have reshaped the war in the Middle East.

stories.title: Houthi attacks reportedly kill at least 30 Yemeni government forces
stories.description: The Houthis say they launched missiles and drones at "Saudi military build-ups" in the central provinces of Marib and Hadramawt.

stories.title: Israel strikes south Lebanon after two soldiers killed by explosion
stories.description: Lebanese authorities says one person was killed in the strikes, which came after the first Israeli military fatalities in Lebanon in more than a month.

stories.title: Iranian footballers who defied Tehran become Australian citizens
stories.description: There were among seven to be granted humanitarian visas while playing in Australia - but the other five changed their minds and returned to Iran.

stories.title: Iran says deal with Oman on Strait of Hormuz is in final stages
stories.description: Neither the US or Oman have commented on the proposed agreement on the vital waterway.

stories.title: UN rights chief alarmed by rise in Iran executions since March
stories.description: Volker Türk says 56 people have been executed on national security-related charges, including 27 in cases linked to January's protests.

stories.title: Threat to oil tankers in Middle East worst since start of Iran war, analysts say
stories.description: Fresh attacks on alternative shipping routes have left tankers facing an increasingly complex situation, analysts say.

stories.title: Trump cancels Iran strikes subject to deal being made 'rapidly'

stories.title: Qatar says US-Iran mediation efforts continuing but no direct talks planned
stories.description: There have been conflicting signals from the US and Iran, with Tehran denying President Trump's assertion that talks are under way.

stories.title: What is Iran's Pickaxe Mountain and why does Trump say he wants to bomb it?
stories.description: BBC Verify has spoken to experts and analysed satellite imagery to piece together what we know about the site, and the potential impact of a US strike.

stories.title: Iran-backed Houthis strike Red Sea port of Mocha, threatening shipping routes
stories.description: Yemen’s Iranian-backed Houthi rebels struck a government-held port on the country’s Red Sea coast late Sunday, escalating fears over threats to strategic shipping routes and a potential return to civil war.

stories.title: Trump to demand compensation for Tehran’s ‘conflicts’
stories.description: President Donald Trump says he’ll demand compensation from Iran for people killed or wounded in the US war on Iran.

stories.title: Lebanon ‘files new lawsuit against’ ex-central bank chief Riad Salameh
stories.description: Reports citing judicial sources say former commercial banker also indicted over alleged financial crimes.

stories.title: Iran hierarchy consolidation as IRGC veteran tapped for key security role

stories.description: DUBLIN: A plane landed in Ireland on Sunday carrying suspected transnational cartel boss Daniel Kinahan who was set to face trial after being extradited from the United Arab Emirates, a journalist saw. stories.description: In only a few years, the surveillance start-up Flock has installed more than 100,000 license plate reader cameras across the United States. stories.description: Iran and the U.S. are not engaged in direct talks, and Tehran will not start them ⁠as long as Washington breaches an interim deal signed in June, Mr. Aragchi said, adding that messages were being exchanged through intermediaries.
